name: Pistol squats
description: A pistol squat is a squat on one leg, with the other leg held straight in front. Lower as deep as possible, then stand back up.

items.content: One leg straight out in front
Standing foot flat, knee tracking over the toes

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Deepest single-leg squat, the other leg straight out in front, chest up, arms forward.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Standing tall on one leg, the other leg straight out in front, arms forward.
